newsitem.title: PERU: Peru April agriculture up 4.6 pct vs yr ago-report.
newsitem.headline: Peru April agriculture up 4.6 pct vs yr ago-report.

text.p: Peru's agriculture grew 4.6 percent year-on-year in April and 11.0 percent year-on-year for the first four months of 1997, state news agency Andina said Wednesday, without giving comparative figures for 1996.
The sector was likely to grow about seven percent this year, according to the Agriculture Ministry, Andina added.
The Peruvian economy's overall year-on-year growth in the first quarter this year was 4.8 percent, compared with 0.6 percent in the same period 1996.
The government is set to publish early next week statistics for April gross domestic product (GDP) growth.
Players on the Lima Stock Exchange expected these figures to show April recording the strongest monthly growth so far this year, brokers said.
